info.title: Azizam
info.description: OpenAI-compatible gateway plus native workflow routes. Discover with `GET /gateway/v1/workflows` and the `x-azizam-workflows` list in this document: each workflow names its sync route, its async route, and where every input goes. Slow work (video, long music) goes through an async route: submit, poll, then fetch the content.

request.description: The body you would send to the matching sync route: `/v1/images/generations` (image.generate), `/v1/audio/generate` (audio.generate, music.generate, sfx.generate) or `/v1/videos` (video.generate).

400.description: Invalid input. `error.message` names the field and the rule.

403.description: Not permitted by the app profile.

post.description: Async route for image, audio and video generation. Poll `GET /gateway/v1/media/jobs/{job_id}` until `status` is terminal (`succeeded`, `failed`, `canceled`), then fetch `/gateway/v1/media/jobs/{job_id}/content` for signed asset URLs.

post.summary: Score how well the faces in an image match reference faces

reference.description: Reference photo(s) of the real people. Repeat the field for several photos.

people.description: JSON array of people. Each: {label?, image? (index of an uploaded photo, default 0), box? [x1,y1,x2,y2] in that photo's pixels, description?, infant? (overrides the age guess)}. A person with several photos: {label, images: [0, {image: 2, box: [..]}]}; entries that repeat a label merge. Each reference may also say generate:false to be used for scoring only (sunglasses, profile, tiny face). The first photo is the anchor (give a box if it holds several faces); in later photos without a box the face that looks like the anchor is chosen, and a photo with nobody who matches is skipped with a warning. Without a box, people are matched to faces one to one by infant:true (youngest face) and age/gender words in label or description; ambiguous cases fail with 400 ambiguous_faces and the list of detected faces, never a guess. Omit to auto-detect: every face of a single photo, or the largest face of each of several photos.

pooling.description: How several reference photos of one person are scored: closest photo, or the mean over all.

thresholds.description: JSON object overriding match, uncertain and min_margin.

items.description: label, verdict match|uncertain|mismatch|missing, reliability normal|low, match{candidate_face,bbox,scores,score,margin}, notes

post.summary: Put the people from reference photos into a new scene, with likeness scores

image.description: Reference photo(s) at full resolution. Never send tiny face crops: the gateway crops roomy heads itself. Several photos of one person are welcome: list them in people[].images.

prompt.description: The new scene, poses and gaze. People are tagged for you.

people.description: JSON array of people. Each: {label?, image? (index of an uploaded photo, default 0), box? [x1,y1,x2,y2] in that photo's pixels, description?, infant? (overrides the age guess)}. A person with several photos: {label, images: [0, {image: 2, box: [..]}]}; entries that repeat a label merge. Each reference may also say generate:false to be used for scoring only (sunglasses, profile, tiny face). The first photo is the anchor (give a box if it holds several faces); in later photos without a box the face that looks like the anchor is chosen, and a photo with nobody who matches is skipped with a warning. Without a box, people are matched to faces one to one by infant:true (youngest face) and age/gender words in label or description; ambiguous cases fail with 400 ambiguous_faces and the list of detected faces, never a guess. Omit to auto-detect: every face of a single photo, or the largest face of each of several photos.

attempts.description: Maximum seeds to try; stops early when every person meets the threshold. ~2 min each.

resolution.description: Per-reference pixel budget. Default: 1536 for up to 3 images, 1280 up to 5, 1024 beyond.

photo_as_canvas.description: Also pass the first photo whole as the style, clothing and setting reference.

pooling.description: How several reference photos of one person are scored: closest photo, or the mean over all.

max_refs_per_person.description: Reference heads sent to the generator per person: the best by size, sharpness and frontal pose. All photos are used for scoring.

refine.description: Per-person head refinement after composing: auto refines people below the match threshold, all refines everybody. A pass is kept only if it helps that person and hurts nobody.

pose_policy.description: likeness rewrites profile / forehead-touching requests to a three-quarter view and says so in warnings[]; as_written keeps your wording.

mode.description: async returns 202 with a media job (poll_url, content_url); auto is async unless attempts=1 and refine=off. sync holds the connection for minutes.

facing_each_other.description: Two people only: prefer, and stop early on, results where both heads are turned toward each other (landmark yaw; head turn, not gaze).

thresholds.description: JSON object overriding match, uncertain and min_margin.

200.description: Best image plus likeness scores (200), or a media job to poll when mode resolves to async (202: id, status, progress, poll_url, content_url)

likeness.description: Same shape as POST /gateway/v1/faces/likeness for the selected image

items.description: person, pass, score_before, score_after, others_before, others_after, accepted
attempt, seed, status, min_score, scores{label: score}, selected

post.description:
Re-enable a disabled App.

DELETE /apps/{id} is a one-way soft-disable. This endpoint is the undo
— the smallest honest fix that lets the optimistic-disable flow offer a
toast with an "Undo" action. Idempotent: enabling an already-active app
is a no-op that returns 200 and the current record.

get.description:
List audit events with optional server-side filters and keyset cursor pagination.

Query params:
  limit        — page size (default 50, max 200 per page); pagination
                 via ``next_cursor`` makes the full log reachable beyond
                 a single page.
  actor_id     — exact match on actor_id (e.g. ``usr_…`` or ``cli``).
  action_prefix — matches events whose action starts with this prefix
                  (e.g. ``service.`` or ``app.``).
  before       — keyset cursor returned as ``next_cursor`` from a prior
                 response, encoded as ``"<created_at>:<id>"``; fetches
                 the next page older than that position.

Response:
  { "records": [...], "next_cursor": "<created_at>:<id>" | null }
  ``next_cursor`` is null exactly when no more rows match the current
  filter — ``"End of audit log"`` territory for the UI.

post.description:
Check access (design §3.1): the decision an App's request would get.

``{"app": app_id, "request": {...}}`` evaluates the App's two plans as
the runtime does; ``{"plan": plan_id, "request": {...}}`` evaluates one
plan on both sides (an App that is "Same as its person").

Authorization: AdminAuthenticator / _require_admin; owner/admin/superadmin. Browser session mutations require CSRF/action headers; bearer calls do not.

Everything one plan (or an App's two plans) can and cannot use.

``{"plan": plan_id}`` or ``{"app": app_id}``. Returns ``plan_ids``,
``summary`` (``usable`` of ``total`` entries, and how many are
``blocked`` or ``unknown``), ``groups`` (the same counts per group)
and ``entries``: one per Models page entry with ``state`` (allowed,
partial, blocked, unknown), ``rule`` (the code, kind, id, name and plain
sentence of the rule that decided it, allowed or not), ``reason`` (the
sentence, when something is blocked or cannot be told), ``points_to``
(the model an alias reaches) and ``kinds`` when one entry is allowed for
some kinds of work and not others. The owner gets the full rule; an
administrator gets it without the name of a restricted category. It makes
no model request and costs nothing.

Re-derives all backend host constants (KOBOLD_HOST,
LLM_BACKEND_HOSTS, TTS_HOST, STT_HOST, EMBEDDINGS_HOST, COMFY_HOST …)
without a process restart.  Requests that arrive after this returns will
see the new values.

its config-file changes.

get.description:
Export the canonical YAML reproducing the running gateway's service registry.

Returns clean YAML containing every service's connection, capabilities,
models, priority, role, and lifecycle — everything an operator would commit
to reproduce this gateway.  Ephemeral runtime state (health history,
last_used_at, probed windows, live VRAM) is excluded.

The output is round-trippable: it matches the shape the existing
seed-import path already understands.

Owner only. It holds the public configuration and, for each secret, a configured entry; it never holds a
secret value (decision D26), so it cannot restore a secret.
